title: abutilon oxycarpum var. incanum
intro: Abutilon oxycarpum var. incanum, commonly known as the Indian mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Abutilon oxycarpum var. incanum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
